original_test_intent: Validate AST1060 recovery-of-last-resort by presenting a deliberately bad BMC active region in SPI flash and proving that the Root-of-Trust restores a verifiable, bootable BMC.
original_method: A trained operator confirms provision state, backs up the original SPI, destroys only the approved BMC active region, programs the approved bad-active fixture with DediProg, verifies programmer read-back, boots under stable power and observes AST1060 recovery and BMC health.
manual_activity: A trained operator must connect and configure DediProg, back up the exact SPI device, perform the approved active-region corruption/programming, verify read-back, control the boot sequence and judge physical/recovery anomalies.
required_inputs: Exact AST1060, BMC, board and SPI-device identity
Approved bad-active recovery fixture with hash/signature and region map
DediProg model, firmware, adapter, voltage and pinout
Original full-SPI and active-region backup with checksum
safety_requirements: Do not automate physical programmer control
Prove board, SPI device, voltage, pinout and image compatibility before attachment
Back up and checksum the original SPI before any erase or write
Limit corruption to the engineer-approved active-region boundary
Verify every programmer write by read-back
Maintain stable power and follow the vendor power/isolation sequence
Do not clear SEL, OS or RoT evidence
Stop on mismatch, read-back failure, unexpected RoT state or loss of console
Do not power-cut or retry blindly
Restore only through the approved known-good recovery path
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only BMC, AST1060 provision/verification and firmware pre-state
Validate supplied artifact metadata and operator checklist
Record target, programmer and backup identities
Present the exact manual sequence and request OK
Do not drive DediProg, erase or write SPI
After the operator completes the physical procedure, collect AST1060 recovery and verification evidence
Verify BMC boot, management health and firmware identity
Preserve SEL, console and audit deltas
Report facts for the end-user verdict
engineer_actions: Approve recovery fixture and known-good restore image
Authorize trained physical operator and DediProg setup
Own recovery escalation and final DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The generic SSH placeholder plus `ipmitool mc info` neither corrupts/programs the physical BMC SPI nor proves AST1060 restored the bad active region. It is only a possible post-state inventory check.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Manual-only vendor procedure: record `aspeed-pfr-tool -p show`, back up the exact SPI, have the operator program the approved bad-active fixture with DediProg and verify read-back, boot under stable power, then collect AST1060 verification/recovery and BMC boot/management evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The BMC RoT recovery target, provision-state check, deliberate active-region destruction, physical DediProg step, recovery boot and 15/15-minute source timing are preserved; no region address, programmer setting or image is guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an approved, versioned RoT recovery work instruction with immutable artifacts, region map, full-SPI backup, programmer read-back, stable-power controls and independently captured AST1060/BMC evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the physical ownership and recovery controls explicit, preserves logs instead of clearing them, and separates manual SPI programming from safe agent evidence collection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Covers the source's physical bad-active-region injection and AST1060 recovery path; a software capsule rejection or a simple BMC version query does not provide equivalent coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong voltage, pinout, SPI target, region boundary or image can brick the BMC or alter RoT-relevant state. Software evidence cannot prove the physical write/read-back step without the operator record.

project_override_considerations: The source explicitly requires DediProg programming of the BMC SPI after destroying the active region. Treat this as board-level manual work, not as an ordinary remote firmware-update command; preserve the provisioned AST1060 state unless the approved recovery procedure explicitly says otherwise.
expected_evidence: AST1060 provision/verification and BMC firmware pre-state
Bad-active fixture hash/signature and approved region map
AST1060 detection, recovery and final verification output
BMC boot, firmware inventory and management health
No hardware PASS claim by the agent

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master, DeepSeek and GPT V2 all identify a destructive BMC recovery exercise. GPT V2 correctly exposes that the source's DediProg SPI operation is physical and cannot be replaced by DeepSeek's generic remote placeholder.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Purpose, target operation and acceptance direction are identifiable. The vendor procedure, fixture, programmer setup, backup, operator and approval are execution prerequisites; their absence does not make the review semantics irreducible.

review_improvement: Corrects the PARTIAL automation implication by assigning the destructive physical SPI operation to a trained operator and defining the exact evidence an agent may safely collect before and after AST1060 recovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: This testcase is not a normal BMC firmware upload. Its fault stimulus is a physical SPI state created with DediProg after deliberate active-region destruction, so remote automation cannot reproduce the required electrical attachment, target selection, voltage/pinout validation or independent read-back safely. The acceptance evidence must show both that AST1060 detected and repaired the bad active region and that the BMC returned with verified firmware and healthy management services. A version query alone cannot distinguish true recovery from an untouched or wrongly programmed flash. Because the operation is clear but physically hazardous, MANUAL ONLY is more accurate than PARTIAL and BLOCKED is unnecessary once the standard vendor/operator package is supplied.
